Add services

Choose services to run alongside your agents.
Existing services and their data will be kept.

  postgres
  redis

Services (space-separated, or press Enter for none): postgres redis

✓ Services added to .agent/compose.yml
  postgres → db
  redis → redis

✓ Network rules added to .agent/project.yaml
  service db:5432 · TCP
  service redis:6379 · TCP

Approve network access, then start services:
  → coop approve
  → coop up
